milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the birch door and face it to demonstrate they have found it. The door is at spawn-relative (3, 0, 2). max_distance=5 and facing_tolerance=60 ensure the player is close and looking at the door.

Uses inventory_has because mining birch_wood blocks causes them to drop as birch_wood items into the player's inventory. The scene has birch_wood blocks (all-bark variant) at the trees, and mining them yields birch_wood items. Only 1 is needed to confirm the mining action, though the player will likely mine more for crafting.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted birch_sign ends up in the player's inventory after crafting at the crafting table. The recipe (6 birch planks + 1 stick) produces 3 birch signs, so checking for min_count=1 is sufficient to confirm the craft was completed.
